description: Price Reduced! Stunning center-atrium Eichler featuring soaring 10-foot ceilings in the living and dining areas. This highly desirable floor plan offers 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms with seamless, single-level living and effortless flow from room to room. Floor-to-ceiling windows guide you through the home and out to the backyard, while the sunlit central atrium and transom windows fill the space with natural light throughout the day. The open-concept kitchen is beautifully updated with new quartz countertops, an extended peninsula with seating, a new stainless steel French-door refrigerator, and a new oven. The bedrooms and main living areas strike the perfect balance of classic Eichler style and modern comfort, showcasing signature mahogany paneling alongside fresh, contemporary finishes. Step outside to a thoughtfully landscaped backyard featuring a new paver patio, a large pool, surrounded by lush greenery, succulents, mature landscaping, and the privacy of backing to open space. The home also includes a well-functioning radiant heating system and a spacious two-car side-by-side garage, offering comfort and convenience.  Ideally located near Northgate shopping, close proximityto transportation, the Civic Center Farmers Market, and more. This home delivers the best of mid-century design and modern living.
